TOPIC 10.6
Comparison Tests 
for Convergence

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

LIM-7.A 
Determine whether a series 
converges or diverges.  
bc only

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

LIM-7.A.8 
The comparison test is a method to determine 
whether a series converges or diverges.  
bc only

LIM-7.A.9 
The limit comparison test is a method to 
determine whether a series converges or 
diverges. bc only

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

LIM-7
Applying limits may allow us to determine the finite sum of infinitely many terms.
